Who We Are

Music That
Moves Worlds

Neocomus Music is an independent music production company founded by international singer and lead producer Olivia Oya Kaptan. We craft original music with real vocalists, real songwriting, and cutting-edge production — distributed globally via DistroKid to every major platform.

We also offer professional services to artists who want their music produced, promoted, and heard — from songwriting and full production to social media growth and playlist pitching.

What We Offer

Services

From full music production to organic growth strategies — we handle every step of your artist journey.

Music Production

Full-service songwriting, composition, recording and cutting-edge production. We write your story and give it a voice that resonates worldwide.

Custom quote

Global Distribution

Your music released to 50+ platforms worldwide via DistroKid — Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, Amazon Music and beyond.

Included in production

Organic Growth

Real audience building via Spotify playlist pitching (SubmitHub, Groover), TikTok / Reels / Shorts strategy, and influencer partnerships.

From $99 / month

Social Media Management

Full social media presence management — content creation, scheduling, audience engagement, and cross-platform growth campaigns.

From $199 / month

Music Licensing

Royalty-free and exclusive licensing for brands, films, games and content creators. Custom compositions available for commercial use.

From $50 / track

Playlist Pitching

Professional Spotify editorial and independent playlist pitching service. Get your music in front of curators who matter.

From $49 / release

The People Behind the Music

Our Team

Olivia Oya Kaptan
Founder · Lead Producer · Songwriter · Vocalist

International singer, lead producer and the creative force behind Neocomus Music. A graduate of 9 Eylül University's Fine Arts — Musicology department and a Berklee College of Music certified artist, Olivia has been performing on stage since 1995 — singing in 8 languages across jazz, blues, Latin, pop and soft rock. She brings decades of craft and a fearless creative vision to every project.

Founder
Instagram YouTube Facebook X Apple Music
BK
Barbaros Kaptan
Founder · Producer · Songwriter

Known as Bob Captain, Barbaros produces and writes the Neocomus catalogue alongside Olivia. A student of song at heart, he completed Berklee's Songwriting Specialization and Vocal Production program in 2026, and holds a Harvard Business Review certification in business strategy and an IBM AI Engineering certification. He works behind the scenes — writing, producing, and making sure the music finds its way to the world.
